title: Implement param validation and coercion at load time with new closed violation ids
question_or_target: Validate params when a Workflow is loaded, not when a unit finally runs. A missing required param, a type mismatch, an out-of-enum value and an unknown param key each produce a DISTINCT violation id, and the id set stays closed (no free-form strings).
answer: tools/agentspec/agentspec/validate.py now validates Workflow params in load_workflow / validate_params_at_load. Four fixtures emit param-missing-required, param-type-mismatch, param-out-of-enum, and param-unknown-key. Unknown keys are strict-parser (spec:11302). run_unit accepts only LoadedWorkflow, so a failed load cannot run. AST-enumerated VIOLATION_* constants equal DOCUMENTED_VIOLATION_IDS (computed set equality). A planted undocumented id turns the closure probe red. The 28-id VIOLATIONS tuple for validate_workflow is unchanged; the four param ids are a separate closed set. SUCCESS:IMP-0134

evidence.claim: Four param-violation fixtures yield four distinct closed ids; unknown key is strict-parser.
AST-enumerated VIOLATION_* constants equal the documented set; planted undocumented id turns the test red.

negative_controls.description: Insert VIOLATION_PARAM_PLANTED = 'param-planted-undocumented' into a copy of validate.py. AST constants then differ from DOCUMENTED_VIOLATION_IDS.
Valid twin (enum member, coerced integer, secret_ref) loads and run_unit runs.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 re-parses validate.py via ast and does not trust probe 1's id list. Equality is computed set equality.

residual_unknowns.claim: VIOLATIONS (28 graph/shape ids) and DOCUMENTED_VIOLATION_IDS (4 load-time param ids) are two closed sets in one module. IMP-0148 owns AST-closure of every id validate.py can emit.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: IMP-0148 AST-derived id set vs documented union of both closed sets.

notes: G-1 for IMP-0134: live named probes exit 0, receipt state=SUCCESS, per-unit manifest row. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. cloud ok=true is not delivery. SUCCESS:IMP-0134
